colour_profiles.source: Experiment 27, optional-colour proxy: P(next coloured | previous plain), P(next coloured | previous coloured)
colour_profiles.licence_note: jazz profile derived from the Jazz Harmony Treebank, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0

colour_vocabulary.note: which colour, given that a chord is coloured; validity is checked against the local key

opening.source: Experiment 35: one method across corpora; profiles are blended by the corpus mix
opening.note: P(opening token | section class). Stability dial reweights; 0.5 leaves it as measured. Each profile is smoothed towards the v0.1 design prior with 10 pseudo-observations.

destination.source: Experiment 35: one method across corpora; profiles are blended by the corpus mix
destination.note: P(destination | section class); final sections that fade out are excluded. Cadence-strength dial reweights. Each profile is smoothed towards the v0.1 design prior with 10 pseudo-observations.

key_relation.source: Experiment 35: key at section start relative to the home key
key_relation.note: p_depart: share of new interior material not in the home key, per corpus and class. The tonal-departure dial maps 0 to never, 0.5 to measured, 1 to always. The departure shape is pooled across corpora (departures are rare).

scoring.note: weights for the candidate search; transition = mean log probability under the blended chord-change models (replaces root motion when models are present)

motifs.source: authored Roman-numeral motifs, from Experiment 33 model D; mixture set added in v0.1

sources.billboard: McGill Billboard via ChoCo (CC BY 4.0), section level
sources.jazz: Jazz Harmony Treebank (CC BY-NC-SA 4.0), tune level: tune openings and tune chord rate only

transitions.source: Experiment 36: order-3 back-off chord-change models, one method for three corpora
transitions.method:
Experiment 35: measure section-function harmony in three corpora with one method.

  Beatles  : Isophonics annotations (seglab, keylab, chordlab, beat)   section level
  Billboard: McGill Billboard salami_chords.txt via ChoCo (CC BY 4.0)   section level
  Jazz     : Jazz Harmony Treebank (CC BY-NC-SA 4.0)                    tune level only

Usage: python measure_corpora.py <beatles root> <billboard original dir> <jht.json> <out dir>
transitions.licence_note: jazz model derived from the Jazz Harmony Treebank (CC BY-NC-SA 4.0); Billboard model from McGill Billboard via ChoCo (CC BY 4.0)

rhythm.source: Experiment 37: chord-length patterns per span of 4, 2 and 1 bars, half-bar grid, three corpora with one method
rhythm.note: P(pattern | span size, position). Position is cadential for the last span of a section, interior otherwise. Patterns are filtered to the allowed chord lengths (rates) and tilted by the harmonic-activity dial. Patterns seen fewer than 3 times are dropped.
rhythm.licence_note: jazz profile derived from the Jazz Harmony Treebank (CC BY-NC-SA 4.0); Billboard profile from McGill Billboard via ChoCo (CC BY 4.0)

return_preparation.source: Experiment 38: endings of new sections followed by a return (Beatles, Billboard)
return_preparation.note: P(destination | the next section is a return). Jazz has no section data and uses the pop profiles.
